Description: Susceptible individuals become exposed through contact with infectious individuals.
Exposed individuals become presymptomatic infectious.
Exposed individuals are quarantined.
Quarantined exposed individuals become presymptomatic infectious and isolated.
Presymptomatic infectious individuals develop mild to moderate symptoms.
Isolated presymptomatic infectious individuals develop mild to moderate symptoms.
Mild to moderate infectious individuals develop severe symptoms.
Isolated mild to moderate infectious individuals develop severe symptoms.
Severe infectious individuals are admitted to hospital.
Isolated severe infectious individuals are admitted to hospital.
Hospitalized individuals are moved to ICU.
ICU patients are moved to regular hospital care after ICU.
ICU patients die from the infection.
Post-ICU individuals recover.

Name: Latent period
Description: Time from exposure to onset of infectiousness.

Name: Presymptomatic infectious period
Description: Duration of infectiousness before symptom onset.

Name: Infectious period (mild to moderate)
Description: Symptomatic infectious period for mild-to-moderate cases.

Name: Infectious period (severe)
Description: Symptomatic infectious period for severe cases.

Name: Basic reproduction number
Description: Average number of secondary infections from a primary infection.

Name: Time in quarantine
Description: Duration of quarantine for exposed cases.

Name: Relative risk of transmission for cases in isolation
Description: Reduced transmission for isolated cases.

Name: Average length of stay in hospital for cases not requiring ICU care
Description: Duration of hospital stay for non-ICU cases.

Name: Average length of stay in hospital before ICU admission
Description: Duration of hospital stay before ICU admission.

Name: Average length of stay in ICU
Description: Duration of ICU stay.

Name: Average length of stay in hospital after ICU
Description: Duration of hospital stay after ICU.

Name: Probability of severe infection
Description: Probability of severe infection requiring hospital admission.

Name: Probability severe case requires admission to ICU
Description: Probability that a severe case requires ICU admission.

Name: Probability of death in cases admitted to ICU
Description: Probability of death for ICU cases.
